en.headline: Dairy Queen opens first Hong Kong store in Causeway Bay on Saturday
en.dek: The American soft-serve chain returns after nearly 50 years with a flagship at One Causeway Bay and plans three more outlets by year-end.
body: Dairy Queen will open its first Hong Kong store on Saturday at Shop 113 on the first floor of One Causeway Bay in Causeway Bay, the mall built on the site of the former Excelsior hotel.

The chain, which first entered Hong Kong in 1979 under the name Mei Lee Sin before withdrawing, is returning with its signature Blizzard soft-serve treats that remain in the cup when turned upside down, along with cones, milkshakes, parfaits and a croissant topped with soft serve.

According to the operator, the Causeway Bay flagship will open from 11am to 10pm. Three further stores are planned before the end of the year in Kwun Tong at The Angle, in Yuen Long at YOHO MALL I, and in Tung Chung at Citygate Outlets.
The company has said it aims to open 60 locations in Hong Kong by 2034 under a development agreement announced last year.

zh.headline: Dairy Queen重返香港 銅鑼灣旗艦店周六開業
zh.dek: 美國軟雪糕連鎖近半世紀後再度進駐，銅鑼灣One Causeway Bay旗艦店周六開幕，年內再開三間分店。
body: Dairy Queen將於周六在銅鑼灣One Causeway Bay一樓113號舖開設香港首間分店，該商場建於前卓美亞酒店舊址。
品牌於1979年以「美利仙」名義進駐銅鑼灣後撤出，今次回歸帶來招牌Blizzard暴風雪軟雪糕，以及雪糕筒、奶昔、芭菲及牛角包雪糕等。
業者表示，銅鑼灣旗艦店營業時間為上午11時至晚上10時。年底前再計劃在觀塘The Angle、元朗形點I及東涌東薊城名店倉開設三間分店。
品牌早前宣佈發展協議，計劃於2034年前在香港開設60間分店。
